summary: Iteration 7 covered the new Seller & Product Management admin module end-to-end. BACKEND (pytest /app/backend/tests/test_seller_product_mgmt.py against public preview URL): 3/3 tests PASS. Coverage: (1) seller applications list + non-admin 403 + approve via POST /api/seller/applications/{id}/decide; (2) GET /api/admin/sellers with salesSummary (totalSales, ordersCount); GET /api/admin/sellers/{id}/summary returning seller + salesSummary + products; POST /api/admin/sellers/{id}/suspend toggles isSuspended true/false idempotently; (3) POST /api/admin/products creates status='approved' product with title/description/category/price/stock/inStock/image; GET /api/admin/products lists it; PUT /api/admin/products/{id} updates title/price/stock; POST /api/seller/products/{id}/decide rejects; DELETE /api/admin/products/{id} returns {ok:true}. Additionally verified via curl that a Buyer token receives 403 on /api/admin/sellers, /api/admin/products (GET+POST) — non-admin authz correctly enforced. FRONTEND (Playwright on preview URL with admin auth_token deep-link): /admin loads Admin Control Panel with all 3 required tabs visible (Seller Applications, Product Approvals, Seller Management) plus existing Withdraw/Reviews/Reports. Seller Management tab renders seller-management-table with 14 seller rows; view-seller-<id> opens seller-profile-modal showing seller-sales-summary; suspend-seller-<id> opens suspend-modal, confirm-suspend-btn suspends and row switches to unsuspend-seller-<id> (unsuspend flow correctly requires confirmation modal — good UX). Product Approvals tab renders product-management-panel with add-product-btn; product-modal opens; filling title/price/stock/image/desc + save-product-btn creates product (toast: 'Product added successfully') and it appears in admin-products-table; edit-product-<id> opens modal pre-filled and save persists changes; delete-product-<id> removes row after confirm dialog. Seller Applications tab renders seller-applications-table with approve/reject/view controls. No console errors observed.

issues: Tab buttons (Seller Applications / Product Approvals / Seller Management / etc.) have no data-testid attributes — tests must rely on visible label text. Recommend adding data-testid="admin-tab-{id}" for stable automation.

action_items: (nice-to-have) Add data-testid="admin-tab-<id>" to the tab buttons in AdminPanel.jsx line ~301 for stable Playwright automation.

(code-quality) AdminPanel.jsx is 1105 lines — consider splitting SellerMgmtTable, ProductMgmtPanel, SuspendModal, ProductModal, SellerProfileModal into components/admin/*.jsx (already flagged in prior iterations for AdminConsole.jsx).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.jsx (1105 lines) mixes 6 tab panels + 3 modals in a single file — split into components/admin/{SellerMgmtTable,ProductMgmtPanel,ProductModal,SellerProfileModal,SuspendModal}.jsx.
Tab buttons render from TABS array without data-testid — inconsistent with rest of codebase which uses data-testid liberally (see product/seller row buttons already having testids).
server.py continues to accumulate routes (seller/admin/product endpoints now added) — router-split still overdue (routers/seller.py, routers/admin_products.py, routers/admin_sellers.py).

Admin can POST /api/seller/products acting as seller (test does this) — confirm this is intentional. If a seller-only path is desired, add role gate; otherwise document that admin can act on behalf of any seller.
Product image field accepts arbitrary URL string via product-image-url-input; no validation on URL scheme/length. Consider basic https:// scheme validation and max length.
